verdict.rationale: Microsoft Graph API officially supports posting channel messages (channel-post-messages) and bots/agents can read/react to conversations, with OAuth-scoped token auth confirmed live (401 without token, valid OData schema present). However, community feedback notes API integration is heavier than competitors (requiring full Azure/Graph stack vs simple webhooks), and reading full message history/content via Graph has known application-permission restrictions not addressed in the evidence.
